nav.offlineNoStops: The bus stops aren't saved on this phone yet. Open the app once with a connection.
nav.offlineNoRoutes: The bus routes aren't saved on this phone yet. Open the app once with a connection, then Bus and train plans offline.
route.tap_stop_app: Tap the stop you're getting off at. The app alerts you two stops before it, even with the screen off.
settings.get_off_note_app: Two stops before you get off or change, the phone buzzes "OFF" in Morse code, beeps and shows a notification, even with the screen off.
bug.pictures_note_app: Up to 3. Screenshot a page takes you to the app: go to the page you want, then tap Screenshot this page. It takes the whole page, top to bottom, and brings you back here. A map may come out blank.
theme.materialYouNote: Turn off for the UwU Apps theme.
migrate.done: Your favourites, places and settings are here from before.
map.locate: to show where you are on the map
map.orbit: Drag to tilt and turn the map
app.myicaNote: Have your MyICA QR code ready for immigration.
terminal.ctrlC: Stop it, or clear the line
tour.terminal.2app: The answers show here. ^C stops one that keeps updating, or clears the line; press and hold to select text and copy it.
tour.terminal.3app: exit, Back or this closes it. Settings, Help and extras opens it again.
map.estimated: No GPS here, so this is an estimate.
reminders.exactAlarms: Android may deliver these reminders late. To get them on time, allow Alarms & reminders for SG Bus Timings.
reminders.leaveTimeHome: Time to leave plans from Home when this phone can't say where you are. Save Home in Places so it always has somewhere to start.
desktop.alerts.denied: Notifications are off for SG Bus Timings. Turn them on in your computer's notification settings, then pick again.
desktop.bar.hint: Search stops, buses and commands, or paste a link
desktop.bar.longShot: Long screenshot: the whole page, top to bottom; copies it, and saves it in Downloads
desktop.bar.nothing: Nothing matches. Try a stop’s name or code, or a bus number.
desktop.bar.shot: Screenshot: copies it, and saves it in Downloads
desktop.glance.failed: {name}: couldn't get the timings just now
desktop.glance.starOne: Star a stop to see it here
desktop.location.noWifi: Couldn't work out where this computer is: on Linux it goes by the Wi-Fi networks around, so it needs Wi-Fi turned on. Or search for a stop, address or postal code instead.
desktop.location.off: Location Services are off on this computer. Turn them on in your system's Settings, under Privacy, to use your location.
desktop.location.unknownWifi: Couldn't work out where this computer is from the Wi-Fi around it. Search for a stop, address or postal code instead.
desktop.location.unreachable: Couldn't reach the location service. Check you're online, then try again.
desktop.mapSaveIntro: Keep Singapore's map on this computer, so the live map shows the streets with no connection.
desktop.offline.body: {app} needs the internet the first time it opens. Check your connection, then try again.
desktop.offline.title: No connection
desktop.pane.pick: Pick a stop or a bus to see its timings here.
desktop.shot.body: It's copied too, and in Downloads. Click to show it.
desktop.stillRunningMac: It keeps checking for Service Alerts from the menu bar. Quit it from the menu bar icon, or with ⌘Q.
desktop.stillRunningTray: It keeps checking for Service Alerts from the tray. Quit it from the tray icon.
desktop.stop.widget.title: Show this stop's next buses in a widget on your desktop
desktop.theme.accentNote: Your computer's accent colour for buttons and highlights, with the app's own backgrounds and fonts.
desktop.update.checkConnection: Check your connection and try again.
desktop.update.downloadIt: Click to download it from GitHub, then install it over this one.
desktop.update.downloading: It's downloading. You'll be told when it's ready to install.
desktop.update.failedBody: It tries again within the hour, or click to download it from GitHub.
desktop.update.fromSource: Running from source, so there's nothing to update. The installed app checks for itself.
desktop.update.readyBody: Click to restart and update. Otherwise it updates the next time you quit.
desktop.widget.badBus: Bus numbers are like 21 or NR7, separated by commas.
desktop.widget.needCode: Pick a favourite, or type a 5-digit stop code.
desktop.widget.noFavs: Stops you save in the app show here to pick from.
desktop.widget.none: No buses are due here right now.
desktop.widget.noneOfThose: None of those buses are due here right now.
desktop.widget.offline: Couldn't reach LTA. Click Refresh to try again.
desktop.widget.title: Bus timings
